  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "resolution_time",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "issue_type",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Directly named in the query ('by issue type'); provides well-separated, interpretable categories (vpn, email, database, etc.) that can be grouped and compared against resolution_time."
    },
    {
      "name": "assigned_agent",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Directly named in the query ('by agent'); clean, low-cardinality set of named agents ideal for segmenting resolution_time. Overlaps with original assigned_to but is explicitly the requested dimension."
    },
    {
      "name": "resolver_matches_assignee",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Clean binary flag capturing whether the closer equals the assignee; an interpretable associational variable (reassignment/handoff) that plausibly relates to resolution_time and can be segmented on."
    },
    {
      "name": "failure_mode",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable, well-separated categories (connectivity_loss, no_access, crash_outage) offering an orthogonal lens on the nature of the failure vs resolution_time. Partially correlated with issue_type but adds a distinct semantic angle."
    },
    {
      "name": "affected_system",
      "role": "restatement",
      "is_predictor": false,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Categories are interpretable but largely redundant with issue_type (vpn->vpn, email->email, database->database); it mostly restates the same partition rather than opening a new relationship."
    },
    {
      "name": "issue_severity_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-separated severity-flavored categories (inaccessible, error, outage_down, degraded_slow) that give an interpretable severity-like axis to compare against resolution_time, complementing the existing priority column."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 5,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.75,
  "rationale": "The set strongly supports interpretable EDA on resolution_time. It squarely delivers the two requested dimensions (issue_type, assigned_agent) with clean, low-cardinality categories, plus genuinely informative extra segmentations: resolver_matches_assignee (handoff), failure_mode, and a severity-like signal. The main weakness is redundancy: affected_system, issue_type, and failure_mode overlap heavily in their partitioning, so several columns describe roughly the same underlying dimension rather than opening distinct relationships. No column is opaque or near-constant, and none merely restates resolution_time itself, so informativeness is high but not maximal."
}
